Class CardImageRegistry

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.view.GUI.registry.CardImageRegistry
public class CardImageRegistry extends Object
Singleton registry that maps card IDs to JavaFX images.

Each card in JSON provides an "image" filename. Call CardImageRegistry.getInstance().init(numPlayers) when the player count is known to preload the images.
